rules_rows.rules_text: This market will settle to Yes if the Chicago White Sox lead after the first 5 innings in the Chicago White Sox vs Cleveland Guardians MLB AL Division Series Game 5 scheduled for 2026-10-10 at 8:00PM ET. If the score is tied at the end of the first 5 innings, this market will settle to No. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended before the first 5 innings are completed and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from MLB.

This market will settle to the team that scores more runs in the 3rd Inning in the Chicago White Sox vs Cleveland Guardians MLB AL Division Series Game 5 scheduled for 2026-10-10. If both teams score the same number of runs in the inning, this market will settle to Tie. This market will settle based on the official result of the inning regardless of whether both teams come to bat. If the inning is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two days of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from MLB.

This market resolves to "Yes" if FURIA wins Map 1 of the esports series against MOUZ, scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 1:30 PM UTC. Otherwise it resolves to "No". If Map 1 is not played (for example, the series concludes before that map), is abandoned, or no official winner is declared, this market will resolve to the last fair market price. In the event of a forfeit, disqualification, or concession before the map begins, the market will resolve to the last fair market price; if it occurs after the map has begun and the governing body declares an official winner, the market will resolve based on that result.

Team Total First Downs settles Yes if Maryland records more than 19.5 first downs in the Rutgers vs Maryland College Football game scheduled for Oct 17, 2026. Overtime is included if played. The market will settle based on the official box score at the conclusion of the game. For purposes of this market, stat corrections enforced after the game has been completed will not count. If the game is delayed, postponed, or suspended before this market is determined and is not resumed or rescheduled within two days of the originally scheduled date, it will be flagged for manual last-fair-market-price settlement. Outcome sourced from the relevant governing body.

This market will settle to the winner of the VAN Canucks vs NYR Rangers NHL game scheduled for Oct 11, 2026 at 6:00PM ET. Overtime and any shootout are included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended, or otherwise rescheduled and is not rescheduled to start within two calendar days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from NHL.

This market will settle to the winner at the end of regulation (60 minutes) in the FLA Panthers vs BUF Sabres NHL game scheduled for Oct 12, 2026 at 1:00PM ET. If the game is tied after regulation (60 minutes), the market will settle to Tie. Overtime and any shootout are not included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended, or otherwise rescheduled and is not rescheduled to start within two calendar days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from NHL.

This market will settle to the winner at the end of regulation (60 minutes) in the MIN Wild vs FLA Panthers NHL game scheduled for Oct 10, 2026 at 6:00PM ET. If the game is tied after regulation (60 minutes), the market will settle to Tie. Overtime and any shootout are not included if played. If the game is delayed, postponed, suspended, or otherwise rescheduled and is not rescheduled to start within two calendar days of the originally scheduled date and time, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from NHL.

This market will settle to the winner at the end of 90 minutes plus stoppage time in the Atalanta BC vs Páfos FC UECL match scheduled for 2026-10-15 3:00PM ET. If the match is tied following 90 minutes plus stoppage time, the market will settle to Tie. If the match is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from UEFA.

This market will settle to the winner of Set 2 of the Shcherbak Denys vs Lazebnyi Ruslan Setka Cup Ukraine Men match scheduled for Oct 9, 2026. If the match does not begin due to a walkover, withdrawal, or cancellation, the market will settle to $0.50. If the match is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two days of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to $0.50. If the match begins but ends before Set 2 is completed, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from Setka Cup Ukraine Men.
